notes.title: Falling Rain Open Beta coming soon !!!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We are proud to share that Falling Rain has officially received support from MDEC (Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation), the Malaysian government’s tech & creative industry agency! [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tf4/1/16/2728.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With this support, we’re now preparing to launch our OPEN BETA soon on Steam! [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t50/1/16/1f525.png"][/img][/p][p]You will be able to playtest the game, experience the combat, explore the story, and help us shape the future of Falling Rain together.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll announce the exact date and how to join very soon, so stay tuned! [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t5c/1/16/1f5d3.png"][/img][/p][p]Your feedback during this phase will be super valuable as we move closer to the full release.[/p][p][/p][p]Music theme song:[/p][p][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/4uuKF45POVisenNuT0qSJg"]https://open.spotify.com/album/4uuKF45POVisenNuT0qSJg[/url][/p]

notes.title: LEVEL UP PLAY Event Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!!

From September 13 - 15th, 2024, you can join us at the LEVEL UP PLAY event.
I'll be there to showcase our game and chat with all of you.
This is a great opportunity to see the game in action and connect with the community.

Looking forward to seeing you there and let's have fun together!!
